name: Ben-Hanan
title: Son of Shimon in the lineage of Judah
summary: Ben-Hanan was one of Shimon's sons in the genealogy of Judah, mentioned alongside Amnon, Rinna and Tilon.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in the genealogy of Judah
keyEvents.description: Ben-Hanan is listed among the sons of Shimon in the tribe of Judah.
